about: Advanced Automation (AAU), FH Technikum Wien master's programme, summer term 2021: the 28 Rechenbeispiele of Kubinger (2021a) and the three MATLAB lab tasks (Kubinger 2021b; Kubinger and Lang 2021), animated step by step, each step with the MATLAB that gives its result. Equations from the slides of Kubinger (2021), cited by PDF page as 'slides p. N' (docs/sources/slide-conventions.md); solution-sheet values from the handwritten sheets S1, S2 and M, cited by file and page (docs/sources/solution-sheets.md). tests/unit/labs-data.test.js recomputes every practice answer with the core.
examsAbout: The calculation tasks (Rechenbeispiele) of the past exams in Prüfungen\, by year and group; theory questions left out. The exams have no solution sheet: every answer is worked here, recomputed by the core and checked by definition in tests/unit/exams.test.js. Where an exam leaves constants or component values open, the question sets them and says so. Each task links the lab that animates its kind of exercise, and its questions also appear in that lab's Practise tab.

questions.question: a12 = −K3/K1, with K1 … K11 set to 1 … 11 here?
questions.source: AAU_Pruefung_SS2014_Klausur_GrA.pdf, RB3, p. 6: no solution sheet; worked here (the exam leaves K open)
questions.solution: ẋ1 = −(K2x1 cos x1 + K3 sin x2 + K4u)/K1; sin x2 → x2, so a12 = −K3/K1 = −3.

questions.question: b2 = −K8/K5, with K1 … K11 set to 1 … 11 here?
questions.source: AAU_Pruefung_SS2014_Klausur_GrA.pdf, RB3, p. 6: no solution sheet; worked here
questions.solution: ẋ2 = −(K6 sin x1 + K7x2 cos x2 + K8u)/K5, so b2 = −K8/K5 = −8/5.

questions.source: AAU_Pruefung_SS2014_WH-Klausur_GrA.pdf, RB1, p. 2: no solution sheet; worked here

questions.question: a12 (the sin x2 · cos x3 term)?
questions.source: AAU_Pruefung_SS2017_Klausur_GrA.pdf, RB3, p. 6: no solution sheet; worked here
questions.solution: ẋ1 = 1.3x1 + sin x2 cos x3 − 2.2u; at 0 the slope in x2 is cos 0 · cos 0 = 1.

questions.question: a31 (the atan term)?
questions.source: AAU_Pruefung_SS2017_Klausur_GrA.pdf, RB3, p. 6: no solution sheet; worked here
questions.solution: ẋ3 = −atan x1 − 0.7u; d/dx atan x = 1/(1 + x²) = 1 at 0.

questions.question: the entry of cᵀ for x3?
questions.source: AAU_Pruefung_SS2017_Klausur_GrA.pdf, RB3, p. 6: no solution sheet; worked here
questions.solution: v = −2.8x1 + 0.3x2 − 4.4x3²; the slope of x3² is 2x3 = 0 at the working point.

questions.question: a22 (the x2 · cos x2 term)?
questions.source: AAU_Pruefung_SS2017_Klausur_GrB.pdf, RB1, p. 2: no solution sheet; worked here
questions.solution: ẋ2 = −1.35x1 − 2.1x2 cos x2 − 2.1 sin x3; d/dx (x cos x) = cos x − x sin x = 1 at 0.

questions.question: a33 (the atan term)?
questions.source: AAU_Pruefung_SS2017_Klausur_GrB.pdf, RB1, p. 2: no solution sheet; worked here
questions.solution: ẋ3 = −2.7x2 − atan x3 + 1.2u; the slope of atan at 0 is 1.

questions.question: b3?
questions.source: AAU_Pruefung_SS2017_Klausur_GrB.pdf, RB1, p. 2: no solution sheet; worked here
questions.solution: ẋ3 = … + 1.2u; u enters no other equation, so b = [0; 0; 1.2].

labs.title: Controllable, observable, stable?
